name: manual_7fa7d6
claim: When computing which commits a branch move would lose, count only independent holders: a symbolic ref such as refs/remotes/origin/HEAD is an alias of a ref that may itself be the one being moved, so it must be skipped, or an undeclared commit on origin/main is wrongly treated as safe. A commit is at risk only when no ref outside the moved set reaches it; a named branch that is legitimately ahead (an integration branch) is not a reason to refuse, a detached HEAD is.

decisions.notes: Found 2026-10-14 (UTC 2026-10-13) applying the qualified-reset gate to the fork-main scripts in orama-system PR 404: the first implementation let an undeclared commit through because origin/HEAD counted as an independent holder; test_an_undeclared_unique_commit_on_the_remote_blocks_the_rewrite caught it. Grounded in lesson_fdb82283644f and lesson_881de77084d5.
